title: See the patient’s lab orders
summary: In the patient file: their orders in progress and finished, the overdue ones and how to create a new one.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; click one to open their file on the right.

steps.title: Search for the patient
steps.details: By name, email or ID document.

steps.title: Open their file
steps.details: Click the patient in the list. The guide continues once their file is open.

steps.title: In progress
steps.details: Each order with its progress through the stages, days in stage and due date. Before booking the fitting, check the job has arrived.

steps.title: Alerts
steps.details: Overdue, due within 7 days or without a lab; one click filters them.

steps.title: Finished
steps.details: Delivered or cancelled, with how many days each one took.

steps.title: New order
steps.details: Records a job for this patient without leaving their file.

steps.title: View in Lab Orders
steps.details: Opens the module filtered by this patient.
